# Theta sketch test fixtures

The `.sk` files are Theta sketches produced the way Iceberg-Java's Spark
`ComputeTableStats` action produces the `apache-datasketches-theta-v1` blobs it
writes to Puffin statistics files. They are generated by
`dev/theta-fixtures/GenerateThetaFixtures.java` (see its README to regenerate)
and consumed by `table/stats/sketch_test.go`.

The generator replays Spark's `ThetaSketchAgg` with the DataSketches-Java
release Iceberg pins (6.2.0): an ALPHA update sketch per partition, non-null
values hashed from `Conversions.toByteBuffer`, partials merged through a union,
and the result stored as an uncompressed compact sketch (serialization
version 3). The Go tests rebuild each sketch from the same values, encoded with
iceberg-go's literal serialization, and compare decoded state: emptiness,
theta, and retained hashes. Raw bytes are not compared, because
DataSketches-Java sets a few preamble fields differently.

| file | input | Java ndv |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `null_only.sk` | only nulls | 0 |
| `boolean.sk` … `uuid.sk` | one fixture per primitive type, 3 partitions, with duplicates and nulls | see test |
| `string.sk`, `binary.sk` | include empty values, which Java skips | 499, 299 |
| `string_empty_only.sk` | only empty strings | 0 |
| `merge_exact_partitions.sk` | 4 partitions of 1500 longs each, 5100 distinct overall | 5102 |
| `single_partition_at_k.sk` | 1 partition of 4096 distinct longs | 4096 |
| `single_partition_estimation.sk` | 1 partition of 6000 distinct longs | 6007 |
| `multi_partition_estimation.sk` | 3 overlapping partitions of 6000 longs, 12000 distinct overall | 11973 |

Every fixture up to `single_partition_at_k.sk` must decode identically to the
sketch iceberg-go builds. In the two estimation fixtures a single partition
holds more than 4096 distinct values, where the ALPHA and QuickSelect families
keep different samples; those are checked against each other's error bounds.

UUID values are hashed from their 16-byte single-value serialization, as the
Puffin spec requires. Spark reads Iceberg `uuid` columns as strings, so
sketches written by the Spark action for UUID columns hash the 36-character
text form instead and will not match.
